status: Production baseline for animation and later engine implementation; no gameplay changes in this batch

decisions.selected: All three use jab 1 → opposite-hand jab 2 → front-kick jab 3. No rapid-jab branch.
decisions.art: Existing nine-drawing jab 1 plus new six-drawing jab_2 and jab_3 sheets per fighter.
decisions.engine: Current MoveId.JAB is a single move. Add stage/cancel/buffer rules and separate combat data; preview timing is not final frame data.

decisions.selected: Up special ends in helpless freefall for all three until landing or a valid ledge catch. Side special does not automatically cause helplessness.
decisions.art: New helpless_enter, helpless_loop and helpless_land per fighter.
decisions.engine: Add explicit state/event, aerial resource eligibility and landing rules; do not infer from an animation ending.

decisions.selected: One ground jump plus one air jump per fighter. Short/full hop share takeoff art. No multi-jump ability.
decisions.art: Neutral/forward/back takeoff, rise/apex/fall/fastfall loops and double-jump transition.
decisions.engine: Retain hasDoubleJump contract; authoritative trigger/phase data must survive skipped snapshots. This batch changes no jump physics.

decisions.selected: Swift only; no wall cling. All-Rounder and Lincoln have no standalone wall-jump ability. Wall techs remain a shared defensive family.
decisions.art: Swift reuses existing wall_tech_jump push-off and new air_rise_loop; no new bespoke wall-jump sheet required.
decisions.engine: Current server wall-jump path is not roster-gated. Add eligibility before claiming this kit is implemented; audit current resource/decay rules.

decisions.selected: Eight world directions with facing preserved independently. Forward/backward horizontal and diagonal source poses are selected relative to facing; vertical poses mirror only with facing.
decisions.art: Eight source-pose families per fighter, including three dedicated backward directions. Whole-body travel mirroring is replaced by facing-preserving selection.
decisions.engine: Preview verifies all sixteen direction/facing combinations. Current authoritative dodge direction capture/physics and event hooks still need implementation.

decisions.selected: Reuse current mirrored roll drawings; independently tune forward/backward timing and travel.
decisions.art: No additional body sheet required for this baseline.
decisions.engine: Separate timing/travel metadata and invulnerability policy remain engine work.

decisions.selected: No high/low angling of the same tilt or smash in the baseline. Existing up/down attacks remain separate moves.

Keep four current categories: neutral close-range burst, side rushing strike, up rising recovery and down counter. Ground/air uses shared body drawings with appropriate anchors; no transformation, tether, weapon, reflect or absorb variant.
decisions.art: Existing specials/counter art plus helpless set. No new travelling-projectile artwork in this baseline.
decisions.engine: Neutral special comments mention projectile spawn but the existing execution path uses local hitbox data. Reconcile naming/zero-active-frame execution and canonical timing; no projectile feature is claimed here.

decisions.selected: No crawl, wall cling, extra air jumps, automatic turnaround, command-input subsystem or stance changes for these baseline kits.
decisions.engine: These are intentional kit exclusions, not universally required shared actions.

decisions.selected: Deferred to the later casual-mode expansion; remain outstanding toward broader Ultimate feature parity.
decisions.art: Design each item interaction, status family and fighter Final Smash before producing its sheets.
decisions.engine: Not implemented or waived by completing the core roster.

decisions.selected: Lock animation families now, reconcile authoritative move timing before final combat polish.
decisions.art: Jab 2/3 preview contact is drawing four; durations remain adjustable metadata.
decisions.engine: Resolve duplicated timing tables and previously recorded 20/23 entry disagreements, then author jab follow-up data and event markers.
